rows.en:
A rookie operator who makes up for inexperience with natural
cheer and hard work. Her looks and manner make people think
she's younger, which bothers her a lot. (CV: Kimiko Koyama)

A big-sister operator whose precise orders can be gentle or
strict. A bit pushy at times, but she looks after others, and
the crew adore her as a big sister. (CV: Tomo Adachi)

A prodigy operator whose talent was recognized while young.
She hates being treated like a child and always strives to be
an equal. A bit foul-mouthed, but endearing. (CV: Ai Nonaka)

A skilled operator who judges calmly. His harsh words get him
misunderstood; he's just bad at showing emotion and is warm
at heart. Glasses are his trademark. (CV: Kiyotaka Furushima)
An elite U.N. Forces officer, chief combat controller of the Macross air wing. A stiff, duty-first type Hikaru treated like an "old lady," she slowly falls for him. (CV: Mika Doi)
rows.notes: Misa Hayase (operator). Subject of the last clause is Misa: she grows fond of Hikaru.

rows.en: A lieutenant from the New U.N. Forces General Staff, sent to S.M.S. as an observer. Through the battles with the Vajra, she gradually gets back together with her ex, Ozma. (CV: Sanae Kobayashi)
Macross 7 fleet staff officer, whose vast knowledge made him a key aide. With Captain Max away, he helmed the Battle 7 as acting captain, showing superb skill. (CV: Ryusuke Obayashi)

VF-0 Ghost Booster
All-out assault spec using Ghosts as boosters.

VF-0 Reactive Armor
Add-on armor with missiles mounted all over.

SV-51 Twin Booster
Decisive-battle spec fitted with 2 jet boosters.

VF-1 Super Pack (TV)
Booster units enhance firepower and thrust.

VF-1 Super Pack (Movie)
The Valkyrie's standard gear for space.

VF-1 Strike Pack
Strike gear only leaders' units may carry.

VF-1 Armored Pack
Add-on armor with missiles mounted all over.

VF-11B FAST Pack
Booster units enhance firepower and thrust.

YF-19/VF-19A FAST Pack
A compact FAST Pack designed for stealth.

YF-21/VF-22 FAST Pack
A compact FAST Pack designed for stealth.

VF-11C FAST Pack
Booster units enhance firepower and thrust.

VF-11 Full Armored
Add-on armor with missiles mounted all over.

VF-11MAXL Kai Sound Booster
Fires sound beams powered by Song Energy.

VF-17T Kai Sound Booster
Fires sound beams powered by Song Energy.

VF-19 Kai Sound Booster
Fires sound beams powered by Song Energy.

VF-17 Super Pack
Gear with weapons upgraded to fight the Protodeviln.

VF-19 Atmosphere/Space Booster
Gear that works both in and out of the atmosphere.
rows.notes: Booster name is a plain translation (no glossary entry); description shared with u3454.

rows.en:
VF-25 Super Pack
The Messiah's standard gear for space.

VF-25 Super Pack
Klan wears the Super Pack herself.
rows.notes: Klan's giant form fitted with the VF-25 Super Pack.

rows.en:
VF-25 Armored Pack
Armored gear that transforms to all 3 modes.

VF-25 Tornado Pack
Gear that works both in and out of the atmosphere.

Armored Pack (Final Battle Spec)
Final-battle spec: Armored plus a sniper rifle.

VF-25 Fold Speaker
A speaker that amplifies the effects of song.

VF-171EX Armored Pack
Armored gear loaded with anti-Vajra weapons.

VF-2SS Super Armed Pack
SAP: the Valkyrie II's standard equipment.

SNN Valkyrie Large Booster
A large booster for the SNN Valkyrie.

U.N. Forces pilot. Shot down by Nora, he washes up on Mayan
Island and meets Sara. They clash, but slowly bond.
A fool who'd risk his life for a woman. (CV: Kenichi Suzumura)

U.N. Forces ace. A tough survivor of the Unification Wars and
a drinker whose motto is "Fear booze? Then you can't fight!"
Above all, a man who loves the open sky. (CV: Akira Kamiya)

Priestess of Mayan Island, Guide of the Wind. Overly hostile
to outsiders, she's hard on Shin too. But in the fight for AFOS
fragments, she slowly bonds with him. (CV: Sanae Kobayashi)
An Anti-U.N. Forces pilot whose family the U.N. Forces killed. Good enough to down Shin twice, she teamed with Ivanov to run rings around the U.N. Forces. (CV: Minami Takayama)

Anti-U.N. Forces ace pilot and Focker's former instructor.
Known as "Daisy Ivanov," he flies well enough to treat Focker
as a mere fledgling. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)

A civilian pilot. Meeting Lynn Minmay, caught in a Zentradi
attack, he becomes a military pilot to protect her. Indecisive,
he wavers between two women. (CV: Kenji Nojima)

A veteran of the Unification Wars, as strong with drink and
women as in combat. Hikaru's senior, adored as a big brother.
Skull Squadron's leader and trusty ace. (CV: Akira Kamiya)

A pilot who shone from his very first sortie. Nickname: Max.
He beats the enemy ace Milia in battle, and this leads to him
later marrying the alien Milia. A rare talent. (CV: Sho Hayami)

Ex-Zentradi pilot. She sneaked into the Macross to find the
one who shot her down. She found Max, dueled him and lost.
He then proposed, and they married. (CV: Eri Takeda)

Hikaru's subordinate, a big, happy-go-lucky guy. His jokes
in battle get him in trouble; Hikaru or Max save him. A cheery,
easygoing goof, hard to hate. Avg. skill. (CV: Katsumi Suzuki)
Support-character Misa does not appear.

Poster girl of Chinese diner Nyan-Nyan, she won Miss Macross
and became a top idol. Free-spirited, she toyed with Hikaru's
tender crush to her heart's content. (CV: Mari Iijima)

The top idol of the Macross. Through the "Minmay Attack," she
caused a culture shock that ended the interstellar war. A
legendary diva remembered for generations. (CV: Mari Iijima)

Zentradi division commander. Warlike and hotheaded, he rides
out front himself, bent on sinking the Macross. While many
chose to live with Earth, he sought battle. (CV: Kosuke Meguro)
A Meltrandi pilot. Known as "Milia the Ace," she was a crack pilot feared even by Zentradi soldiers. After losing her fight with Max, she marries him. (CV: Eri Takeda)

U.N. Forces pilot Maximilian Jenius in macronized form. To
cover the Macross in the final battle with the Boddole Zer Main
Fleet, he flew a Queadluun-Rau with Milia. (CV: Sho Hayami)

Giants created by the ancient Protoculture through genetic
engineering. Bred as combatants, they never knew "Culture,"
and overreact when they first encounter it.

Zentradi fleet commander. A master strategist, he corners the
Macross again and again. Touched by forbidden Culture in that
fight, he opts to coexist with Earth. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)

Zentradi fleet commander. Contact with Culture awakened the
Culture asleep within him. In the final battle he turned on
Boddole Zer to fight for the Macross. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)

Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander. Fearing a myth that
Protoculture contact saps the will to fight, he deems cultured
humans Protoculture, to be destroyed. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)

Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander, and the central
bio-unit of his flagship. He grasps a little of Culture, and will
use any means, however cruel, to win. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)

Chosen as a new fighter's test pilot for his superb flying skill.
He grew up with Myung and Guld but cut ties after an incident.
Dalmatian High School's wild child. (CV: Takumi Yamazaki)
Yang does not appear.

Chief developer of the YF-21, a BDI-system prototype, and its
pilot too. He clashes hard with Isamu over the next-gen fighter
race and childhood friend Myung. (CV: Unsho Ishizuka)
Sharon's producer. Once childhood friends with Isamu and Guld, she cut ties after an incident. Reunited with them on Eden after 7 years, she is torn between the two. (CV: Rika Fukami)
rows.notes: tm fixed: 'on Eden 7 years later' read like a place called 'Eden 7'.

rows.en:
A virtual idol who became the galaxy's No. 1 right after debut.
With songs that have a hypnotic effect, she controls people
and plunges Macross City into chaos.
"My profile? You shouldn't go digging into people's pasts. Forget that and listen to my song! Wanna know about me? Listen to my song and you'll get it. Here we go!" (CV: Nobutoshi Canna)
rows.notes: Basara speaking in his own voice; seiyuu romanized as in u3501.

rows.en:
FIRE BOMBER's new vocalist. Max and Milia's child, she has
flown Valkyries since she was little, so she's a fine pilot too.
At an age where two boys are on her mind. (CV: Tomo Sakurai)

An elite pilot who joined special assault unit Diamond Force
young. He saw Basara, who sings in battle, as an enemy, but in
time trusts him and the power of song. (CV: Takehito Koyasu)

For his service in the Zentradi war, he became commander of
the Macross 7 colony fleet. Though retired, his genius piloting
is intact, and he flew Valkyries in ops. (CV: Sho Hayami)

City 7's mayor and a former Zentradi ace pilot. She still sorties
when City 7 is attacked, and citizens back her as their fighting
mayor. (CV: Eri Takeda)

Leader of FIRE BOMBER. A former U.N. Forces ace, he left the
military after an incident. Always backing Basara and Mylene,
he claims he's 28, which is doubtful. (CV: Masashi Sugawara)

FIRE BOMBER's drummer. Taciturn, she rarely speaks, and
mostly communicates through her drums. A pure-blooded
Zentradi with extraordinary strength.
Support-character Exsedol does not appear.
rows.notes: Same form as the prefilled u3470 ('Support-character Misa does not appear.').

rows.en: Miho Miho does not appear.
Docker does not appear.
Kinryu does not appear.

As Varauta Army commander, he was to raid Macross 7 for
Spiritia, but he defies Gepelnitchi's orders to awaken one of
his comrades, "Sivil". (CV: Tomohiro Nishimura)

He took over the Varauta Army from Gigile and tormented the
Macross 7 fleet. He dubs all he sees some kind of "Beauty". He
can fuse with Glavil into his ultimate form. (CV: Akio Suyama)

Varauta Army Supreme Commander, with the dread power to
drain all the galaxy's Spiritia. For his Spiritia Farm Project,
meant to give endless Spiritia, he relentlessly hunted Basara.

A Protodeviln girl. Drawn to Basara's song, she seeks him
out again and again. In the end she sings with him and evolves
into a self-regenerating Spiritia race. (CV: Akiko Nakagawa)

"The galaxy sure has some strange folks in it..." -- Graham
(CV: Nobutoshi Canna)

A taciturn man bent only on killing the white Galaxy Whale that
took his right arm and his wife. Oddly, he hit it off with Basara,
which surprised even his daughter Elma. (CV: Joji Nakata)
Liza does not appear.

A sunny, innocent, slightly ditzy girl from planet Zola who
dreams of being a pro singer. How she makes it and her name
rings across the galaxy is a tale for later. (CV: Aya Sakaguchi)

A high schooler in pilot training who becomes a Valkyrie pilot
after a Vajra attack. Born to a famed kabuki line, his gift and
looks once had him play female roles. (CV: Yuichi Nakamura)

Alto's classmate, a crack sniper. Motto: "Enemies or women, I
bring down whatever I aim at." He and Klan go way back. His
older sister was also a soldier and sniper. (CV: Hiroshi Kamiya)

uncertain: u3450: 'VF-19 Atmosphere/Space Booster' is a plain translation (no glossary entry for this booster).
u3484: tm changed ('on Eden 7 years later' -> 'on Eden after 7 years') to avoid reading as a planet 'Eden 7'.
